risk_note: RV2 (db/**). Adds migration 0065 app.notification_settings, one row per (app_id, user_id) with a composite foreign key to app.users (no cascade), three boolean NOT NULL switches without defaults (service_push, subscription_push, marketing_push; an account without a row reads all three as true in the reader, B1-12m, per the contract), row_version and timestamps. Grants in the same migration: couli_app SELECT, INSERT and column-level UPDATE on the three switches, row_version and updated_at only, no DELETE; couli_readonly SELECT. Additive only; no existing table changes. Storage decision (own table, writer notification, not columns on users whose writer is identity) is the orchestrator's technical decision, recorded for planning write-back (04 §3.2). Migration number taken under the migration slot (D10-116) as main max + 1; schema.sql and db.gen.ts regenerated with pnpm db:snapshot on the test machine. No money, no attribution.
